definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese confections, typically made from plant-based ingredients like rice flour, sweet beans, and sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒に：25645_isshoni⟧{和菓子|わがし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Have Japanese sweets together with tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{和菓子|わがし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: Seasonal Japanese sweets are beautiful in appearance too.

examples.japanese: {和菓子|わがし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{洋菓子|ようがし}→洋菓子：04998_yougashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{甘|あま}さ→甘さ：21344_amasa⟧⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控え目：09160_hikaeme⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Japanese sweets are less sweet than Western sweets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{和菓子|わがし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought Japanese sweets at a long-established shop in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {和菓子|わがし}⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かたどった→象る：10345_katadoru⟧⟦{練|ね}り{切|き}り→練り切り：28742_nerikiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ→一つ一つ：27163_hitotsuhitotsu⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The sight of a wagashi craftsman handmaking nerikiri shaped like seasonal flowers one by one is truly an art.

notes:
Traditional confections served with ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ (matcha) or ⟦{煎茶|せんちゃ}→煎茶：13407_sencha⟧. Categories:
- ⟦{生菓子|なまがし}→生菓子：27039_namagashi⟧ (fresh confections) - high moisture, short shelf life
- ⟦{半生菓子|はんなまがし}→半生菓子：28743_hannamagashi⟧ (semi-dry) - medium moisture
- ⟦{干菓子|ひがし}→干菓子：noentry⟧ (dry confections) - low moisture, long-lasting

Common types:
- ⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧ (mochi with filling)
- ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧ (steamed bun)
- ⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧ (sweet bean jelly)
- ⟦{最中|もなか}→最中：28020_monaka⟧ (wafer with filling)
- ⟦{煎餅|せんべい}→煎餅：04958_senbei⟧ (rice crackers)
- ⟦{練|ね}り{切|き}り→練り切り：28742_nerikiri⟧ (nerikiri - artistic molded sweets)

{和菓子|わがし} often reflect ⟦{季節感|きせつかん}→季節感：20736_kisetsukan⟧ (seasonality) in their shapes and colors, representing flowers, leaves, or seasonal motifs.

Contrast: ⟦{洋菓子|ようがし}→洋菓子：04998_yougashi⟧ (Western-style sweets).
